newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - AUG 13.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - AUG 13.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Wheat harvest has been completed on 90 percent of the sowing area. The crop average is very different, with two to 2.5 tonnes on some places and six to seven on other areas.
- Almost 9,000 young men will start their military service on Wednesday and Thursday. Fourty percent of the conscipts are unsuitable.
- The state privatisation agency (APV)'s board and the management of Postabank Rt are negotiating about an 11 billion forint worth of portfolio swap.
